• Citizens can build a new Sky Passage each age.
• Units can enter Sky Passages to instantly teleport
between them.
• All units have +4 Line of Sight.
• Oracles generate +25% Favor at full Line of Sight.
• Damaged enemy units remain visible for 25 seconds.

1904.Name: poseidon
1904.Description:
• Militia spawn from razed buildings.
• Cavalry, Caravans, and Myth Units gain +0.1 speed per
age.
• Stables and Markets are 30% cheaper.
• Market exchange rates improved by 15%.
• A free Hippocampus respawns at the first Dock.

1905.Name: quetzalcoatl
1905.Focus: Focus: Warrior Priests and Nobles Hut Warriors.
1905.Description:
• Warrior Priests generate 0.05 Favor per second by
performing Bloodletting at Temples.
• Calpullis and their additions cost -33%.
• Nobles’ Hut units +15% hitpoints.
• Eagle Warriors +2 Range.
1905.God_Of: GOD OF WIND, ARTS, AND WISDOM

1906.Name: ra
1906.Focus: Focus: Migdol Stronghold units and Empowerment.
1906.Description:
• Laborers gather from Berry Bushes 25% faster.
• +15% Camel Rider, Chariot Archer, and War Elephant
hitpoints.
• Pharaoh-empowered Monuments empower nearby
buildings (60% efficiency of Pharaohs).
• Priests can empower (60% efficiency of Pharaohs).

1907.Name: set
1907.Description:
• Pharaohs can summon Animals of Set.
• Priests can convert wild animals, but converted
animals lose 25% of their Food.
• +5% Spearman, Axeman, and Slinger speed.
• Barracks, Siege Works, and Migdol Strongholds cost
-25% Gold.
• Monuments reduce the cost of units in nearby
Barracks and Migdol Strongholds by 10%.

1908.Name: shennong
1908.Focus: Focus: Farming, Myth Units, and Healing.
1908.Description:
• God Blessing: Gift of Beasts
• On Favored Land: Myth units recover 1.5 hitpoints per
second, increasing by 1.5 per age.
• Farms are available in Archaic Age, and build instantly
on favored land.
• Plow, Irrigation, and Flood Control are researched
instantly for free in their respective ages.
1908.God_Of: GOD OF AGRICULTURE AND HERBAL MEDICINE

1909.Name: susanoo
1909.Focus: Focus: Myth Units and God Powers.
1909.Description:
• Tributes a larger Favor reward with each Bushid6 tier.
• Myth units earn Bushid6 XP passively, and through
combat.
• Invoking a God Power makes others 25% cheaper to
reinvoke.
• Unit special abilities recharge 25% faster.

1910.Name: tezcatlipoca
1910.Description:
• Every 2 Myth Units lost spawn an Obsidian Shard; if
the Shard survives long enough, it summons a free
Myth Unit of the current age.
• Tzompantli Towers and Traps are built 25% faster and
inflict +25% damage.
• Devoting Settlers grants +10%/+20%/+30%/+40%
more Favor per age.
• Jaguar Riders are unlocked an age earlier.
1910.God_Of: GOD OF OBSIDIAN, DARKNESS, AND SORCERY

1911.Name: thor
1911.Description:
• Start with Dwarves instead of Gatherers.
• Dwarves cost -10 Gold, and gather Food and Wood
nearly as fast as Gatherers.
• Dwarven Armory can be built and research upgrades in
any age.
• Receive a free Dwarf for each Dwarven Armory
upgrade researched.
• Can research 3 extra Dwarven Armory upgrades.
1911.God_Of: GOD OF THUNDER, LIGHTNING, AND THE SKIES

1912.Name: tsukuyomi
1912.Description:
• Increases Shinobi and Cavalry attack with each
Bushid6 tier.
• Each technology researched grants Bushid6 XP.
• Advancing to the next Age is 25% faster.
- A free Kitsune appears at the Temple each Age.

1913.Name: zeus
1913.Description:
• Starts with 10 Favor.
• Gains Favor 20% faster.
• Myth units cost 1 less population.
• Infantry do +60% damage to buildings.
• Hoplites move 15% faster.

1915.Name: gift of beasts (god blessing)
1915.Description:
| Shennong summons myth units from the next Age at your
Temple for free as you earn Favor.

1916.Name: way of the moon (bushido)
1916.Description:
Tsukuyomi grants:
• Cavalry & Shinobi: •3% attack /% per Bushid6 tier
achieved.
« # Guardhouse, 4. Dojo and #j)Stable Soldier upgrades
granted for free at each Bushido tier

1918.Name: way of the sun (bushido)
1918.Description:
Amaterasu grants:
• A permanent trickle of +1.0 & /second per Bushid6 tier
achieved.
- # Guardhouse, 4. Dojo and #j)Stable Soldier upgrades
granted for free at each Bushido tier

1919.Name: yin and yang (god blessing)
1919.Description:
Fuxi grants alternating bonuses, which swap every 4
minutes:
• Yin: Peasants and Kuafus gather + 10% faster.
• Yang: Human soldiers and siege weapons +10% damage.

1923.Name: predatory instinct
1923.Description:
• Lykaon: Adds 2.00 to Melee Attack Damage (Hack)
• Lykaon: Speed •8.33%

1924.name: Deconstruction
1924.NAME: Deconstruction
1924.LR: Target an enemy building to deconstruct it. The target player will get their resources back but lose the building.
1924.Name: deconstruction

1925.name: Shockwave
1925.NAME: Shockwave
1925.LR: Target a location on the map to send enemy units flying, stunning them for a few seconds.
1925.Name: shockwave

1926.name: GaiaForest
1926.NAME: Gaia Forest
1926.LR: Select a location to grow a Gaia Forest. Villagers gather wood faster from Gaia Trees.
1926.Name: gaia forest

1927.name: Carnivora
1927.NAME: Carnivora
1927.LR: Spawns a giant plant that pulls humans and ships in and devours them.
1927.Name: carnivora

1928.name: Valor
1928.NAME: Valor
1928.LR: Target one of your human units to convert it into a hero and heal it fully.
1928.Name: valor

1929.name: SpiderLair
1929.NAME: Spider Lair
1929.LR: Target an area to place spider eggs which will hatch and burrow. The spiders will devour enemy human soldiers that cross through the area, but eggs can be destroyed before they hatch.
1929.Name: spider lair

1930.name: Traitor
1930.NAME: Traitor
1930.LR: Target an enemy unit to convert it to your side.
1930.Name: traitor

1931.name: Chaos
1931.NAME: Chaos
1931.LR: Target a group of enemy units to make it temporarily hostile to all.
1931.Name: chaos

1932.name: HesperidesTree
1932.NAME: Hesperides Tree
1932.LR: Select a location to create a tree that summons some Dryad myth units and can train more.
1932.Name: hesperides tree

1933.name: Vortex
1933.NAME: Vortex
1933.LR: Target a location to transport all of your military units there.
1933.Name: vortex

1934.name: TartarianGate
1934.NAME: Tartarian Gate
1934.LR: Hekate opens a gate to the Underworld that unleashes creatures hostile to all. The gate will destroy any buildings in the vicinity when it is placed.
1934.Name: tartarian gate

1935.name: Implode
1935.NAME: Implode
1935.LR: Target a location to do massive damage to nearby units and buildings. This is more powerful when cast near a large number of enemy units.
1935.Name: implode

1936.name: BloodPact
1936.NAME: Blood Pact
1936.LR: Target any unit to grant it immense power for a short duration. When the effect ends, the unit dies, granting you Favor.
1936.Name: blood pact

1937.name: Tailwind
1937.NAME: Tailwind
1937.LR: Target a group of friendly units to boost their movement speed for a short duration.
1937.Name: tailwind

1938.name: ObsidianMirror
1938.NAME: Obsidian Mirror
1938.LR: Target any player to secretly copy their Archaic Age God Power.
1938.Name: obsidian mirror

1939.name: Lullaby
1939.NAME: Lullaby
1939.LR: Target a group of enemies to put them to sleep. Any damage dealt to sleeping units will wake them up immediately.
1939.Name: lullaby

1940.name: Infestation
1940.NAME: Infestation
1940.LR: Target a location to summon an Infested Nest that periodically spawns Scorpions that obey your commands.
1940.Name: infestation

1941.name: AgaveBloom
1941.NAME: Agave Bloom
1941.LR: Target a location to spawn a sacred Agave. Gather it for Food or let its sacred energy heal your nearby units.
1941.Name: agave bloom

1942.name: EarthMonster
1942.NAME: Earth Monster
1942.LR: Target a location to summon Tlaltecuhtli, the Earth Monster. It erupts from the ground repeatedly to swallow groups of units, trapping them underground before regurgitating survivors.
1942.Name: earth monster

1943.name: Starfall
1943.NAME: Starfall
1943.LR: Target a location to bombard enemies with falling stars. Tzitzimitl star demons occasionally emerge from the craters to fight for you.
1943.Name: starfall

1944.name: Purge
1944.NAME: Purge
1944.LR: Target an enemy military unit to mark it for sacrifice. The unit is suspended in the air, and after a short delay, all nearby enemies of the same type are destroyed, up to a total of 1400 resource value.
1944.Name: purge

1945.name: CorruptedGround
1945.NAME: Corrupted Ground
1945.LR: Target an area to corrupt the earth. Defeated enemies here will be reborn as vile abominations that fight for you.
1945.Name: corrupted ground

1946.name: Volcano
1946.NAME: Volcano
1946.LR: Target a location to raise a mighty Volcano. It obliterates buildings as it rises, and bombards the surrounding area with molten rock.
1946.Name: volcano

1949.name: ThePeachBlossomSpring
1949.NAME: The Peach Blossom Spring
1949.LR: Target a location to create the Peach Blossom Spring, whose resource stockpile grows over time. The Peach Blossom Spring's resources are gathered very quickly, but its stockpile stops growing once a villager starts gathering from it.
1949.Name: the peach blossom spring

1950.name: Creation
1950.NAME: Creation
1950.LR: Target a location to create a number of Clay Peasants that last for a couple of minutes. Spawns more Peasants in later ages.
1950.Name: creation

1951.name: ProsperousSeeds
1951.NAME: Prosperous Seeds
1951.LR: Target 2 Farms to sow the seeds of prosperity. They will produce food faster, heal nearby villagers, and make friendly units on them invisible.
1951.Name: prosperous seeds

1952.name: LightningWeapons
1952.NAME: Lightning Weapons
1952.LR: Target a location to conduct lightning into the weapons of all of your human soldiers, heroes and ships, granting their attacks a chance to stun enemies.
1952.Name: lightning weapons

1953.name: EarthWall
1953.NAME: Earth Wall
1953.LR: Raises earthen walls to surround the targeted area.
1953.Name: earth wall

1954.name: Vanish
1954.NAME: Vanish
1954.LR: Target a group of friendly units to make them invisible for a short time. Attacking will reveal their position.
1954.Name: vanish

1955.name: ForestProtection
1955.NAME: Forest Protection
1955.LR: Target a friendly building to protect the surrounding area with Goumang's wood power, which roots enemies and heals allied units.
1955.Name: forest protection

1956.name: DroughtLand
1956.NAME: Drought
1956.LR: Target an area to spread drought, which makes enemy buildings far easier to destroy, units easier to kill, and prevents all construction and repairs.
1956.Name: drought

1957.name: VenomBeast
1957.NAME: Fei Beasts
1957.LR: Target a location to spawn poisonous Fei Beasts that spread infection to enemies.
1957.Name: fei beasts

1958.name: GreatFlood
1958.NAME: Great Flood
1958.LR: Target a path of destruction for a cataclysmic flood that sweeps away units and annihilates buildings.
1958.Name: great flood

1959.name: BlazingPrairie
1959.NAME: Blazing Prairie
1959.LR: Target a location to open the heavens and set the world on fire. Everything will burn.
1959.Name: blazing prairie

1960.name: YinglongsWrath
1960.NAME: Yinglong's Wrath
1960.LR: Target a location to summon Yinglong, the legendary rain and lightning dragon of China.
1960.Name: yinglong's wrath

1967.name: Pandatopia
1967.NAME: Pandatopia
1967.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all units into Pandas.
1967.Name: pandatopia

1971.name: Rain
1971.NAME: Rain
1971.LR: Target anywhere to make all of your Villagers gather Food from Farms faster, and fishing ships gather Food from fish faster.
1971.Name: rain

1972.name: Prosperity
1972.NAME: Prosperity
1972.LR: Target anywhere to make all of your Villagers and Trade Caravans gather Gold faster.
1972.Name: prosperity

1973.name: Vision
1973.NAME: Vision
1973.LR: Target a region of the map to be temporarily revealed.
1973.Name: vision

1974.name: Eclipse
1974.NAME: Eclipse
1974.LR: Target anywhere on the map to turn day to night, improving the abilities of your myth units and increasing the rate at which your Monuments generate Favor.
1974.Name: eclipse

1975.name: ShiftingSands
1975.NAME: Shifting Sands
1975.LR: Target your own or allied units, and then target the location where you wish to teleport them.
1975.Name: shifting sands

1976.name: PlagueOfSerpents
1976.NAME: Plague of Serpents
1976.LR: Target a location on the map where dangerous Serpents will rise from the ground or sea and protect that area from your enemies.
1976.Name: plague of serpents

1977.name: LocustSwarm
1977.NAME: Locust Swarm
1977.LR: Target a path of destruction. Summons a plague of locusts that attacks enemy units and buildings, devouring Farms, livestock, and Berry Bushes.
1977.Name: locust swarm

1978.name: Ancestors
1978.NAME: Ancestors
1978.LR: Target a location to awaken ancestral soldiers or ships to fight again for a short time.
1978.Name: ancestors

1979.name: Citadel
1979.NAME: Citadel
1979.LR: Select a Town Center belonging to you or an ally to transform it into a mighty, defensive Citadel, which trains units and researches technologies faster.
1979.Name: citadel

1980.name: SonOfOsiris
1980.NAME: Son of Osiris
1980.LR: Target your Pharaoh to transform him into a super-empowering, lightning-wielding demigod.
1980.Name: son of osiris

1981.name: Meteor
1981.NAME: Meteor
1981.LR: Target an enemy area to bombard with burning rocks from the heavens. Strong against buildings, moderately effective against units.
1981.Name: meteor

1982.name: Tornado
1982.NAME: Tornado
1982.LR: Target near an enemy to send a cyclone that will suck their buildings and units up into the sky – but stay out of its way.
1982.Name: tornado

1983.name: Bolt
1983.NAME: Bolt
1983.LR: A bolt of lightning from the sky strikes down any single military unit.
1983.Name: bolt

1984.name: Sentinel
1984.NAME: Sentinel
1984.LR: Target your or an ally’s Town Center, Village Center, or Fortress to protect it with stone guardians.
1984.Name: sentinel

1985.name: Lure
1985.NAME: Lure
1985.LR: Target a location to erect a special stone which draws animals to it and spawns chickens. The Lure summons more food in later ages, and Villagers can drop off food at the Lure.
1985.Name: lure

1986.name: Restoration
1986.NAME: Restoration
1986.LR: Target a location to heal units and repair buildings, siege weapons, and ships belonging to you or your allies.
1986.Name: restoration

1987.name: CeaseFire
1987.NAME: Ceasefire
1987.LR: Target anywhere on the map to prevent every player from fighting and slow the construction of ranged fortifications for a short period of time.
1987.Name: ceasefire

1988.name: Pestilence
1988.NAME: Pestilence
1988.LR: Target an enemy town to infect it with plague. The Pestilence prevents buildings from firing projectiles and slows unit production.
1988.Name: pestilence

1989.name: UnderworldInvasion
1989.NAME: Underworld Invasion
1989.LR: Sacrifice all your Town and Village Centers to resurrect fallen military and Myth units. Settlements cannot be repopulated for some time.
1989.Name: underworld invasion

1990.name: Bronze
1990.NAME: Bronze
1990.LR: Target a location to encase your soldiers, myth units, and ships with bronze, reducing their vulnerability in combat.
1990.Name: bronze

1991.name: Curse
1991.NAME: Curse
1991.LR: Target near enemy soldiers to turn several of their units into Pigs.
1991.Name: curse

1992.name: UnderworldPassage
1992.NAME: Underworld Passage
1992.LR: Select two locations on the map to create entrances to the Underworld through which units can move.
1992.Name: underworld passage

1993.name: LightningStorm
1993.NAME: Lightning Storm
1993.LR: Target a location to call down an electric storm from Olympus whose power increases over time. Strong against groups of enemy units.
1993.Name: lightning storm

1994.name: Earthquake
1994.NAME: Earthquake
1994.LR: Target a location to shatter nearby enemy buildings. The epicenter of the earthquake inflicts the most damage.
1994.Name: earthquake

1995.name: Wither
1995.NAME: Wither
1995.LR: Target a location to wither berries, farms, and trees, rendering the terrain sterile for a short period of time.
1995.Name: wither

1996.name: ArcadianMeadow
1996.NAME: Arcadian Meadow
1996.LR: Target an area to temporarily turn it into a peaceful meadow. Units and buildings inside the meadow cannot attack.
1996.Name: arcadian meadow

1997.name: CommunalHearth
1997.NAME: Communal Hearth
1997.LR: Summon a hearth that increases Villager gather rate and converts enemy units.
1997.Name: communal hearth

1998.name: SolarShield
1998.NAME: Solar Shield
1998.LR: Target a unit to make it temporarily nearly invulnerable.
1998.Name: solar shield

1999.name: Kusanagi
1999.NAME: Kusanagi
1999.LR: Target a location for Susanoo to cast down his sword, Kusanagi. The sword damages nearby enemies and summons a riptide that blasts them skyward.
1999.Name: kusanagi

2000.name: NewMoon
2000.NAME: New Moon
2000.LR: Target a building to obtain all currently available technologies there for free and cause military units to train faster for a short duration.
2000.Name: new moon

2001.name: ShrineOfTheHunt
2001.NAME: Shrine of the Hunt
2001.LR: Target a Shrine to transform it into a Shrine of the Hunt, periodically spawning huntable deer as well as friendly wolves that defend the area.
2001.Name: shrine of the hunt

2002.name: Goshinboku
2002.NAME: Goshinboku
2002.LR: Target a location to summon a Goshinboku tree. The tree's blessing resurrects the owner's myth units as they fall in combat.
2002.Name: goshinboku

2003.name: Swampland
2003.NAME: Swampland
2003.LR: Target a location to create a temporary swamp infested with Kappa that will leap out of the water and drown enemy human soldiers.
2003.Name: swampland

2004.name: Shogun
2004.NAME: Shogun
2004.LR: Target a Daimyo to transform him into an immensely powerful Shogun, who summons Samurai while he fights.
2004.Name: shogun

2005.name: SmitingGust
2005.NAME: Smiting Gust
2005.LR: Target a direction in which to unleash an immense gust of wind, blasting military units across the map.
2005.Name: smiting gust

2006.name: ThunderBurst
2006.NAME: Thunder Burst
2006.LR: Target a location to unleash earth-shaking shockwaves. Raijin strikes his den-den daiko drums, causing expanding rings of lightning to damage and stun enemies.
2006.Name: thunder burst

2007.name: SacredGate
2007.NAME: Sacred Gate
2007.LR: Target a location to erect a great Torii Gate which makes your God Powers cheaper and immediately enables you to invoke them once again for free.
2007.Name: sacred gate

2008.name: DragonTyphoon
2008.NAME: Dragon Typhoon
2008.LR: Target a path of destruction. Watatsumi will descend in dragon form and erupt into a swirling typhoon, tearing through everything in his path.
2008.Name: dragon typhoon

2009.name: DivineSlash
2009.NAME: Divine Slash
2009.LR: Target a path of destruction. Takemikazuchi will cleave the earth with a colossal katana slash, inflicting massive damage to units and stunning any survivors.
2009.Name: divine slash

2014.name: HachimansBlessing
2014.NAME: Hachiman's Blessing
2014.LR: Target Harumoto or a Daimyo to grant Hachiman's blessing, making them much stronger.
2014.Name: hachiman's blessing

2018.name: DwarvenMine
2018.NAME: Dwarven Mine
2018.LR: Select a location to create a new Gold Mine that has more Gold and is gathered faster if used in later ages.
2018.Name: dwarven mine

2019.name: Spy
2019.NAME: Spy
2019.LR: Target an enemy unit to secretly see what it sees.
2019.Name: spy

2020.name: GreatHunt
2020.NAME: Great Hunt
2020.LR: Target a group of wild animals to greatly multiply their numbers. If there are none, Odin will summon a small amount. Gets more powerful each age.
2020.Name: great hunt

2021.name: Gullinbursti
2021.NAME: Gullinbursti
2021.LR: Target one of your Town Centers (or your allies') to summon and command Freyr's golden boar Gullinbursti to defend the area. Gullinbursti becomes stronger each age.
2021.Name: gullinbursti

2022.name: ForestFire
2022.NAME: Forest Fire
2022.LR: Target a forest to burn it to smoldering embers, damaging nearby units and buildings.
2022.Name: forest fire

2023.name: HealingSpring
2023.NAME: Healing Spring
2023.LR: Target a location on the map to create a spring that will heal all nearby friendly units. The spring cannot be destroyed, but can be taken over by enemy forces.
2023.Name: healing spring

2024.name: Undermine
2024.NAME: Undermine
2024.LR: Target a path of destruction along which to damage enemy buildings. Walls and towers instantly collapse, and other buildings take considerable damage.
2024.Name: undermine

2025.name: AsgardianBastion
2025.NAME: Asgardian Bastion
2025.LR: Target a location to summon a foundation that will materialize into a spectral Hill Fort when fully constructed. Builds faster in later ages.
2025.Name: asgardian bastion

2026.name: Frost
2026.NAME: Frost
2026.LR: Target near enemy units to freeze them solid for a short period of time. Frozen units cannot move, but are very hard to kill.
2026.Name: frost

2027.name: FlamingWeapons
2027.NAME: Flaming Weapons
2027.LR: Target anywhere on the map to cause the weapons of all of your human soldiers and ships to burst into flame, increasing their attack for a short period of time.
2027.Name: flaming weapons

2028.name: WalkingWoods
2028.NAME: Walking Woods
2028.LR: Target near a forest to animate the trees to attack nearby enemies. The animated trees are strong against buildings and decent against units.
2028.Name: walking woods

2029.name: Tempest
2029.NAME: Tempest
2029.LR: Target a location to unleash a vicious hailstorm, damaging enemies and heavily slowing their attacks and movement.
2029.Name: tempest

2030.name: Ragnarok
2030.NAME: Ragnarok
2030.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all of your Gatherers and Dwarves into mighty Heroes of Ragnarok.
2030.Name: ragnarok

2031.name: Fimbulwinter
2031.NAME: Fimbulwinter
2031.LR: Target anywhere on the map to summon packs of ferocious wolves to attack enemy Town Centers.
2031.Name: fimbulwinter

2032.name: Nidhogg
2032.NAME: Nidhogg
2032.LR: Select a location to summon the mighty Norse dragon from his delve beneath the earth.
2032.Name: nidhogg

2033.name: Inferno
2033.NAME: Inferno
2033.LR: Target a fiery path of destruction. The great wolf Fenrir will emerge and charge, engulfing enemies in flames before erupting into an apocalyptic inferno of flame and ruin.
2033.Name: inferno

2034.name: TitanGate
2034.NAME: Titan Gate
2034.LR: Target a location to place a Titan Gate. Once your Villagers finish clearing the debris, a Titan will emerge.
2034.Name: titan gate

2037.name: Goatunheim
2037.NAME: Goatunheim
2037.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all units into tasty Goats. BAAAAAAH!
2037.Name: goatunheim

2041.name: Pillar of Tlálocan
2041.LR: Target a location to call down the Pillar of Tlálocan, obliterating fortifications on impact. The statue remains to defend the area with water strikes until destroyed.
2041.Name: pillar of tlálocan

2042.name: Plenty
2042.NAME: Plenty
2042.LR: Select a location to erect this great Vault. The bounty of the gods will flow into your coffers as long as you control it.
2042.Name: plenty
